Asha (CS): quick heads-up — we had an SSO token-refresh regression affecting EU onboarding tenants between 02:07–02:42 UTC. Seeing higher-than-normal failures for new webhooks and SSO flows. I want a concise customer update + renewal-risk check template we can send to affected accounts.
Diego (Eng): root cause: a config rollout reverted token TTL to 5s for short window; retry logic handled some but not all. Fix deployed 02:55 UTC, monitoring green after 03:10 UTC.
Marta (Solutions): thanks. For comms: we should segment by impact level (blocked vs intermittent). Also include live office hours for high-touch accounts.
Priya (Acct Mgmt): list of affected renewals? I have three enterprise deals in the 60-day window — need a bespoke note and credit offer.
Asha (CS): copying the affected list to outreach owners now. Draft below for review — short + transparent. Feedback pls.
Asha (CS): ```
Hi {CustomerName},
We want to let you know about an incident that affected onboarding and SSO for some EU tenants on {date/time window}. New integrations or webhook deliveries may have failed or experienced errors during that time.
Impact: failed onboarding attempts, delayed webhooks, and SSO token refresh errors for new sessions.
What we did: rolled back the config, deployed fix, validated retries and recovery.
Next steps: we will (1) surface retry logs to your account, (2) offer a tailored credit for affected ingestion/requests, and (3) host an office-hours session to walk through any missed data or replays.
If you saw persistent failures, reply and we’ll prioritize a 1:1 with our engineering team.
Sincerely,
Asha and the Redwood CS team
```
Diego (Eng): small suggestion — add a short "what you can do now" bullet with a sample curl to re-send webhook payloads or re-trigger onboarding webhook:
Diego (Eng): ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/replay -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"tenant": "<id>"}'
```
Marta (Solutions): agree, and include a one-click calendar invite link for office hours. Also recommend we surface a snippet for renewal owners: quick impact summary + credit range to expedite renewals conversation.
Priya (Acct Mgmt): propose credit guidelines: 
• blocked onboarding (tenant unusable) -> 3 days of committed capacity credit or fixed $2k credit for self-serve tenants
• intermittent errors -> pro-rated token credit up to $500
Asha (CS): noted. Priya — can you flag the three renewal accounts and I’ll prepare bespoke outreach drafts for each with the appropriate credit option?
Priya (Acct Mgmt): done — flagged and added notes in CRM.
oncall-bot: Incident 2026-03-21-SSO-EU: status -> RESOLVED. Links: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/2026-03-21-SSO-EU
Asha (CS): final checklist before we send org-wide notices: 
- [ ] Localized EU customer list verified (Priya)
- [ ] Draft message reviewed (Marta)
- [ ] Credit amounts approved (Finance ran quick check — verbal ok)
- [ ] Office hours scheduled (Wed 10:00 UTC)
I’ll publish the draft and start targeted outreach in 30 mins. :email::telephone_receiver:
